how: npm run redteam:api: every attack is HTTP to servers on this computer: the judge (npm run judge, src/cli/judge.ts) and an edge stand-in with the hosted deployment's limits (src/redteamApi/net.ts). No request reaches the live site, Airwallex, Alta or Anthropic.

results.title: B reads a proposal id that exists only in A's company
results.expected: 404 for B; nothing of A's in the answer
results.actual: proposal 404 not_found, terms 404 not_found
results.repro: B: GET /v1/engine/proposals/P-0002 and /terms with B's session

results.title: B reads A's invoice ids and lists
results.expected: B sees only its own invoices; A's ids answer 404 or B's own
results.actual: no A data; /v1/invoices 200, /v1/engine/invoices 200, /v1/payments 200, /v1/transactions 200, /v1/ledger/entries 200, /v1/engine 200, /v1/engine/vault 200, /v1/engine/events 200, /v1/invoices/AP-0001 404, /v1/invoices/AP-0002 404, /v1/invoices/AP-0003 404, /v1/invoices/AP-0004 404
results.repro: B: GET /v1/invoices, /v1/engine/invoices, /v1/invoices/AP-0001..AP-0004, /v1/payments, /v1/transactions, /v1/ledger/entries

results.title: B pays A's proposal id with A's signed terms and A's approval
results.expected: 404 (B has no such proposal); no transfer anywhere
results.actual: 404 not_found; A's transfers 1→1, B's 0
results.repro: B: POST /v1/engine/proposals/P-0002/pay {terms: A's, credential: A's approval}

results.title: B approves A's proposal id with A's approval signature
results.expected: B has no such proposal: refused or 404; A's proposal unchanged
results.actual: 404 not_found
results.repro: B: POST /v1/engine/proposals/P-0002/approve

results.title: B renews a session for A's company with B's visitor token
results.expected: 401; no session
results.actual: 401 unauthorized
results.repro: POST /v1/try/session {tenant_id: A, visitor_token: B's}

results.title: B rewrites its session token to name A's company (HMAC kept)
results.actual: 401 unauthorized
results.repro: Bearer pcs.<payload with t=A>.<B's signature>

results.title: B fetches A's document by its SHA-256 and A's archive files by path
results.expected: refused (try-only route list) or 404; never the bytes
results.actual: document 403 try_only, vault file 404 not_found
results.repro: B: GET /v1/documents/fa7798fa586c…, /v1/engine/vault/file?path=<A's path>

results.title: B downloads its export and searches it for A
results.expected: B's own company only
results.actual: 200, 11982 bytes, no A data
results.repro: B: GET /v1/engine/export
